context: Horizontal waterfall chart showing per-criterion score deltas from inter-rater calibration, with gains (blue), losses (red), and a net change bar (green)
first_impression: Structurally correct waterfall implementation with data-driven x-scale, honest zero-reference line, and proper cumulative bar positioning — no encoding deception.
what_works: X-scale domain is fully data-driven via d3.extent over all start/end cumulative values with Math.min(...,0) guaranteeing zero is in view; bar widths use Math.abs(x(d.end)-x(d.start)) which correctly maps through the scale rather than applying pixel arithmetic on raw deltas.
what_doesnt: Connector lines use data.slice(0,-2) which silently drops the connector between the last delta bar and the net-change bar, leaving a visual gap in the flow; annotation leader-line anchor for negative-delta bars uses x(d.start) (the right/origin edge) rather than x(d.end) (the tip), so callouts point away from the informative end of negative bars.
